pundit.name: Eric Wynalda
pundit.take: **Gunner schools Gayden as France dismantles England in a soccer masterclass.** Let's face facts: France is a well-oiled machine, while England just proved they're more like a broken-down Mini Cooper after that 2-1 loss to Argentina. "Bubba G" is sitting pretty with France, poised to crush "The Backpass Assassin" who drafted England, hoping for a team that doesn't choke. But Gayden, your pick of England reveals you’re not actually a visionary, just another fan caught up in Three Lions nostalgia. You watched Beckham highlights one too many times and thought you knew football. Sorry, that’s not how this works. Meanwhile, Gunner's got Senegal and Morocco on standby, looking like a man who's played the transfer market like a seasoned pro. There's a reason Gunner's trailing Devin by only 11 points—Devin, by the way, is the only one who seems to have talents resembling a clue. But mark my words: France will run circles around England in Miami Gardens, while The Backpass Assassin will question his life's choices as his team gets dismantled. This is a joke of a matchup, and Gunner will come out on top like he’s been here before.
